plain_translation: The script is in the wrong place for its type, or it is disabled. A print at the top shows whether it starts.
checklist_fixes: Check the script type: Server scripts run on the server, Local scripts on the client.
LocalScripts must be inside StarterPlayerScripts, StarterGui, or a Tool , not in ServerScriptService.
Add print("Script started") at the top to confirm it runs.
Make sure the script isn't disabled , check the Enabled property.
problem_html: Your Lua script doesn't seem to execute at all. No output in the console, no errors, nothing happens.
prevention_html: Always start scripts with a print statement. If it never shows in Output, the script isn't running , check its parent location.
keywords: script not running output empty server local print error

plain_translation: Gravity is pulling the part down because Anchored is off. Turn it on for floors, walls and props.
checklist_fixes: Select the part and check "Anchored" in the Properties panel.
If it should move but stay in place, use a "BodyPosition" or "AlignPosition" constraint instead.
Use WeldConstraints to stick parts together without anchoring each one.
Parts in Workspace are affected by gravity unless Anchored = true.
problem_html: Your part falls through the baseplate or flies away when you hit Play. It's not staying where you placed it.
prevention_html: Get in the habit of anchoring static parts (walls, floors, props) as you build them. Only leave dynamic parts unanchored.
keywords: part not anchored falling physics gravity unanchored moves

plain_translation: The client and server are not listening on the same event, or the event is not in ReplicatedStorage.
checklist_fixes: Check both scripts are listening on the same event name , typos are the #1 cause.
Local scripts use RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(...) and fire with :FireServer() .
Make sure the RemoteEvent is in ReplicatedStorage so both sides can access it.
problem_html: Client fires a RemoteEvent but the server never receives it, or vice versa. Nothing happens on the other end.
prevention_html: Create a ModuleScript that stores all RemoteEvent names as constants. Import it in both scripts to avoid typos.
keywords: remote event not firing client server bindable event listen

plain_translation: Leaderstats only shows the number. A DataStore has to save and load it when the player joins and leaves.
checklist_fixes: You need DataStoreService , leaderstats alone only creates the display, not persistence.
Use game.Players.PlayerAdded to load saved data into leaderstats on join.
Use game.Players.PlayerRemoving and BindToClose to save data on leave.
Enable API Services in Game Settings → Security → Allow HTTP Requests.
problem_html: Leaderstats reset when the player rejoins. Coins, score, level , all gone on reconnect.
prevention_html: Always wrap DataStore calls in pcall() to prevent errors from crashing your server. Test with Studio play sessions first.
keywords: leaderstats not saving data store saves persistent
